postTitle: Never worry about HTML IDs again: React useId makes accessibility simple and stable
postContent: Need stable, unique IDs for accessibility? React's useId gives you a unique ID for each render that stays stable across re-renders and hydration. It works well with server-side rendering. Use it for aria-describedby, aria-labelledby, and more. This avoids ID clashes when you render multiple components. Here's a minimal pattern to copy.

tehnicalChallange.title: Challenge: Build an accessible input with useId
tehnicalChallange.description: Create a small PasswordField component that uses useId to generate a unique description id, apply aria-describedby to the input, and render the descriptive paragraph with that id. Ensure the IDs remain stable across renders and across server/client boundaries (SSR hydration).
